AUDIT-7 Lane 4 batch 3 progress — 141 valid PRs audited, 4 invalid payload references (2026-11-25)

This slice processed #7889, #7890, #7891, #7893 and #7894:

- #7889 → #1936: `audit:completed-later` via #11171; the four service declarations and feedback loop are now complete.
- #7890 → #4967: `audit:complete` (legacy checkpoint compaction/actionable error).
- #7891 → #1065: `audit:partial` (Rust SDK landed; second SDK/WIT decisions remain). Lane 2 closure pointer: #13871 comment 7159579443.
- #7893 → #6058: `audit:complete` (embedding-cost ledger design).
- #7894 → #5837: `audit:complete` (knowledge graph-view design).

The PR bodies, diffs, comments, source issue/comment captures, later-PR evidence, verdicts and label readbacks are in [the continuation ledger](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/audit7-batch3-five-20261125/doc/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7889-7894/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7889-7894.md), on the existing docs PR #14847.

Cumulative count: 141 valid PRs audited from 145 payload entries; four payload identifiers (#7667, #7668, #7693, #7694) are issues rather than PRs; 105 identifiers remain, next #7896. Earlier count corrections are recorded in comments 7156848591 and 7156775726.
